Context: today, a new flagship game-landing design ("Combined") was piloted successfully on 2 live pages: read `app/(marketing)/rust-server-hosting/page.tsx` and `app/(marketing)/palworld-server-hosting/page.tsx` FULLY as your exact reference pattern, plus `components/marketing/gamelanding/GameLandingCombined.tsx` (the component) and `components/marketing/gamelanding/data.ts` (the `PreviewGame`/`PreviewReview` types — note `PreviewReview` is `{id, quote, role}` only, NO fabricated names or star-ratings; a real `ReviewBadges` component renders separately for real aggregate scores — this is an established brand-honesty decision, do not regress it).

A SEPARATE parallel task is simultaneously migrating 8 OTHER existing game pages (valheim, ark [original], satisfactory, cs2, conan-exiles, 7-days-to-die, project-zomboid, v-rising) — do NOT touch those, work only on your assigned list below to avoid file conflicts (you may both touch `data.ts` to add entries — that's fine, additive changes to the same file from different games rarely conflict, but do NOT edit any `PreviewGame` entry for the 8 games listed above if you happen to see them already there).

Your assigned 9 pages:
1. `garrys-mod-server-hosting`
2. `fivem-server-hosting` (NOTE: this one may not have a `family`/game-identity prop the way others do — check first; if it's not actually a "game family" page in the same sense, i.e. doesn't fit the game-logo-centric Combined design, skip it and report why rather than forcing it)
3. `factorio-server-hosting`
4. `terraria-server-hosting`
5. `unturned-server-hosting`
6. `the-forest-server-hosting`
7. `sons-of-the-forest-server-hosting`
8. `enshrouded-server-hosting`
9. `minecraft-server-hosting` OR `minecraft-bedrock-server-hosting` (check which one, if either, is NOT already using a bespoke/superior existing design — Minecraft is Nxeon's flagship game and may already have special treatment; investigate first, only migrate if the Combined design would genuinely be an upgrade over whatever exists today, and skip with a clear reason if the current Minecraft page(s) already exceed what Combined offers)

For EACH page (except any you determine should be skipped, with a clear reason):
1. Read its CURRENT live page fully first — capture its real, existing metadata (title/description/canonical/OG), real current pricing (`plans[]`), and any real internal links/related content. These are live indexed pages — do not invent or change pricing, only carry it forward accurately.
2. Author the richer `PreviewGame` fields the Combined template needs (`artSlug` from `lib/games.ts`'s `GAME_ART_SLUG`, `accent`/`glow` colors, `kicker`, `headline`/`highlight`, `deck`, `worldName`, `region`, `boot[]` 5 lines, exactly 4 `reasons[]`, illustrative-only `reviews[]`) — add as a new `PREVIEW_GAMES` entry in `data.ts`.
3. Rewrite the live page to render `GameLandingCombined` with real preserved pricing/metadata/JSON-LD, plus an appended FAQ + related-links section carrying over real existing FAQs (don't invent new ones).
4. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after every 2 pages.

Pace yourself for accuracy over speed across 9 pages. If you run out of runway, stop cleanly and report which are done vs. remaining vs. skipped-with-reason.

Report back (table, under 500 words): each page migrated/skipped(why)/not-yet, and final `tsc` status. Flag anything you're not fully confident renders correctly (can't run a dev server here).
